messages:
Maya (Finance Ops): FYI — Zephyr Health wants a 6-mo pilot with a large discount: asking 40% off usage + waive onboarding fee. They also want net60 and a small revenue credit clause. Need finance sign-off, cc @Omar (Account Exec) and @Ben (Finance Manager).
Omar (Account Exec): They are a good logo and would be referenceable. Ask: can we get a 12-mo quote/reference in exchange? 40% feels steep — suggest 30% + waived onboarding up to a cap. Net60 might be ok if we get a PO.
Ben (Finance Manager): Do we have estimated monthly usage and the expected margin at 30/40%? Net60 is an exception to standard net30 and needs director approval. Also need to cap any revenue credit clause.
Maya (Finance Ops): Quick numbers below so everyone has context:
```
Estimated usage: ~2M tokens/mo (generation)
Pricing baseline: $0.003/token -> ~$6k/mo pre-discount
Embeddings & rerank add ~ $1.5k/mo
Total pre-discount ~ $7.5k/mo -> 6mo = $45k
If 40% off -> $27k net over 6mo
If 30% off -> $31.5k net over 6mo
Onboarding fee we're proposing to waive = $8k
Revenue credit ask = up to $10k in case of SLA misses
```
Jess (Legal): Do not accept an open-ended revenue credit. We can agree to a capped service credit tied to SLA, with an aggregate cap (recommend max $5k). Also need to avoid terms that allow them to offset other invoices. I can draft language.
Ben (Finance Manager): My read: approve up to 30% discount + waive onboarding fee up to $8k if Sales secures a public case study and a signed PO for 6 months. Cap service credits at $5k and no offsets. For net60 I need @Rachel sign-off. I can prepare the deal desk memo.
Rachel (Finance Director): I'm willing to approve net60 for this one given it's a short pilot and we get a PO + case study. Approve 30% discount, waive onboarding up to $8k, cap credits at $5k. Send contract draft to legal for the SLA language.
Omar (Account Exec): Customer verbally agreed to case study and 6-mo PO with net60. I'll attach updated SOW and LOI in CRM. Will confirm details tonight.
dealbot: CRM update: Opportunity ZH-783 added discount 30%, onboarding waiver $8k, requires finance director approval. Status -> awaiting contract.
Maya (Finance Ops): Great — action items: Ben to write deal memo, Jess to draft SLA/service-credit language, Omar to upload SOW & PO, Rachel to sign deal memo once received. Moving to drafting stage. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
